```artifact
Feature: Manage Doctors and Chemists in VCMS

  As an administrator, I want to manage doctors and chemists in the VCMS
  so that I can maintain a high-quality healthcare service

Scenario: Adding a new doctor
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Add Doctors"
Then I should be able to add a new doctor

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 1001      | Dr. Smith  | 45  | M  | MD           | 20       |
    | 1002      | Dr. Jones | 38  | F  | PhD          | 15       |

Scenario: Editing an existing doctor
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Edit/Update Doctors"
Then I should be able to edit an existing doctor

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 1001      | Dr. Smith  | 45  | M  | MD           | 20       |
    | 1002      | Dr. Jones | 38  | F  | PhD          | 15       |

Scenario: Deleting a doctor
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Delete Doctors"
Then I should be able to delete a doctor
  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 1001      | Dr. Smith  | 45  | M  | MD           | 20       |
    | 1002      | Dr. Jones | 38  | F  | PhD          | 15       |

Scenario: Adding a new chemist
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Add Chemist/Labs"
Then I should be able to add a new chemist or lab

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 2001      | Lab            | Jane Doe         | 123 Main St      | (555) 123-4567 |
    | 2002      | Chemist        | John Smith       | 456 Elm St      | (555) 456-7890 |

Scenario: Editing an existing chemist
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Edit/Update Chemist/Labs"
Then I should be able to edit an existing chemist or lab

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 2001      | Lab            | Jane Doe         | 123 Main St      | (555) 123-4567 |
    | 2002      | Chemist        | John Smith       | 456 Elm St      | (555) 456-7890 |

Scenario: Deleting a chemist
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Delete Chemist/Labs"
Then I should be able to delete a chemist or lab
  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 2001      | Lab            | Jane Doe         | 123 Main St      | (555) 123-4567 |
    | 2002      | Chemist        | John Smith       | 456 Elm St      | (555) 456-7890 |

Scenario: Error when adding a non-existent doctor
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Add Doctors"
Then I should see an error message "Speciality does not exist" if the speciality is not present
  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 1003      | Dr. Brown  | 50  | M  | None         | 10       |

Scenario: Error when editing a non-existent doctor
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Edit/Update Doctors"
Then I should see an error message "Doctor does not exist" if the doctor Id is not present
  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 1004      | Dr. Green  | 40  | F  | None         | 5       |

Scenario: Error when deleting a doctor with open consultation requests
Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
When I select "Delete Doctors"
Then I should see an error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" if there are open requests |
  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 1001      | Dr. Smith  | 45  | M  | MD           | 20       |

```
